task.statement: {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {R : ι → Type u_3} [(i : ι) → SMul α (R i)] {r : α} [∀ (i : ι), Nonempty (R i)] : IsSMulRegular ((i : ι) → R i) r ↔ ∀ (i : ι), IsSMulRegular (R i) r
task.reference_proof:
@[simp]
theorem isSMulRegular_iff [∀ i, SMul α (R i)] {r : α} [∀ i, Nonempty (R i)] :
    IsSMulRegular (∀ i, R i) r ↔ ∀ i, IsSMulRegular (R i) r :=
  Pi.map_injective
